body: The Weeknd’s compilation album ‘Trilogy’ is a cornerstone of his catalog, changing the culture altogether Comprised of three classic mixtapes in ‘House Of Balloons,’ ‘Thursday’ and ‘Echoes Of Silence,’ Abel spoke on the album’s impact with Rolling Stone in 2015. “It definitely changed the culture,” he said. “No one can do a ‘Trilogy’ again without thanking The Weeknd. ” The album was RIAA certified triple platinum back in 2019, as it celebrates its 14th anniversary today.

source_caption_text:
The Weeknd’s compilation album ‘Trilogy’ is a cornerstone of his catalog, changing the culture altogether 🎈

Comprised of three classic mixtapes in ‘House Of Balloons,’ ‘Thursday’ and ‘Echoes Of Silence,’ Abel spoke on the album’s impact with Rolling Stone in 2015. “It definitely changed the culture,” he said. “No one can do a ‘Trilogy’ again without thanking The Weeknd.”

The album was RIAA certified triple platinum back in 2019, as it celebrates its 14th anniversary today. What’s your favorite mixtape of the original trilogy?
